decisions.reason: An inertial measurement sensor module fits squarely into the firm's modular building-block system, and its own hardware, firmware and API know-how lets it learn from early results and refine the module cheaply.

The industrial AC voltage input module builds on the firm's established power and measurement expertise, is prominently presented on its own page, and supports the move toward industrial and energy-management applications.
A four-channel solid state relay module is a close extension of the existing relay and control peripherals, so the firm fully understands it and can maintain it with little extra effort.

The server room monitoring kit bundles existing sensors and software the firm knows well, but as a kit it faces more market uncertainty and could be consolidated, so the drop risk is somewhat higher, though still below keeping it.
